body: PID14300 confirmed native raycast crash: visual-only seed42 rendered black, ReadyToRender false at frame60, wrote its measurement and finalized normally after30s. Separate native-ray test stopped between before_raycast and after_raycast. Focus plus Alt+N dismissed CSRSS prompt again; fresh UI/process checks verified game exit. No upload. Navigation official control progressed, newly written seed42 prefab returned0 faces. Evidence saved under evidence/runtime/in-game/*14300*. Revised probe keeps failed sample counts, compares preexisting file against runtime-created files, and tests empty-scene loading-state bypass. Build and hash-verified deployment passed; PID29364 launched. Full epic and campaign backend remain incomplete.
